location: Piazza San Marco café arcade, Venice

location: Piazza San Marco café arcade, Venice

location: Piazza San Marco arcade cafés, Venice

location: Venice - lagoon waterfront gondola moorings facing San Giorgio Maggiore (Riva degli Schiavoni / Molo San Marco area)
content: Venice lagoon waterfront in bright clear morning sun: ornate three-arm Venetian cast-iron lamppost with pink glass lanterns standing centre frame against an empty blue sky; wide stone quay, gondola moorings with gondolas under blue covers, yellow/green tarp bundles bottom right, San Giorgio Maggiore and its campanile on the far horizon. content: Rialto Bridge, sunny morning: POV climbing the white stone steps between the bridge's arcaded shop rows (shutters still down) with tourists coming down, then pushing through a dense crowd past shopfronts (backpacks filling frame), ending at the bridge balustrade with a view down the Grand Canal - palazzi, boats, blue sky - over a foreground of tourist heads and hats.

content: Sunny paved square ringed by arcaded buildings (stone porticoes, red-plastered facade): square stone fountain pillar with bronze lion/grotesque-head spouts; strangers refilling plastic water bottles (man in black T-shirt and sunglasses, older woman in pink cap, woman in striped top and sun hat), close-up of a hand holding a bottle under a spout; ends tilting down into the basin with the operator's fingers and shadow in frame. content: Locked-off close-up of the same square's fountain: weathered marble pillar with a bronze lion-head spout pouring a thin sunlit arc of water into the basin; background a red-plastered building with white-framed windows over a dark arcaded ground floor and sunny paving with white stone stripes; a pigeon flies through ~14 s. location: Venice - narrow canal (gondola ride, exact spot unknown)
content: Gondola bow POV through a long, narrow, shaded canal: the prow and its metal ferro centred, weathered brick and stone houses with barred windows, a man on a railed fondamenta at left (~13 s), moored boats under red covers (20-31 s), potted greenery on a bank (~34 s) and another gondola far ahead at the end; dim, flat light.
camera_motion: steady continuous forward glide (push-in), slight pan left after 30 s
best: 9.0-12.0s (straight one-point canal view with the ferro centred) / 20.5-24.0s (red-covered boats moored along the canal)
notes: Redundant with the other bow POVs of the same ride.

location: Venice - narrow canals with stone bridges (gondola ride, exact spot unknown)
content: Gondola POV through narrow canals under a string of bridges, soft shaded late-afternoon light: opens on a woman in a long black gown and white opera gloves posing on canal-side steps for a photographer in a dark suit (0-4 s), a hand waves across the lens (~3 s), then the prow approaches a brick arched bridge with an iron lattice railing and pedestrians crossing, a second bridge framed through its arch (5-9 s), passes under it (10-13 s), approaches another bridge lined with tourists beside lit shop windows (14-21 s), passes under (22-25 s) and glides down a narrow canal of weathered brick and peeling plaster (27-41 s).
camera_motion: steady forward glide (push-in) with slight tilts up toward the bridges; brief pan right/roll ~3-6 s; passes under arches ~10-13 s and ~21-25 s
best: 5.5-8.5s (brick bridge with lattice railing and pedestrians, a second bridge seen through the arch) / 17.0-20.5s (bridge lined with tourists, warm shop windows at left, sharp) / 0.0-2.0s (woman in black gown and white gloves posing for a photographer on canal steps)
notes: Strangers' photo shoot at the start (faces small). One of the best canal sequences of the ride.

location: Venice - narrow canal (gondola ride, exact spot unknown)
content: Gondola bow POV in a very narrow, deep canal: first half tilted up at towering weathered brick facades with a small white room overhanging on brackets, a companion's hand pointing up (~1.5 s); second half levels to a crisp one-point view down the canal with green shutters, arched doorways and brick walls; dim shaded light, bright clipped sky.
camera_motion: steady forward glide (push-in) throughout; tilted up 0-12 s, tilts down to level ~12-15 s
best: 18.5-22.5s (crisp symmetrical POV down the canal with green shutters) / 6.0-9.0s (looking up the towering facades past the overhanging white room)
notes: Similar to DJI_0169/0176 bow POVs.

location: Venice - canal basin with moored gondolas (gondola ride, exact spot unknown)
content: Gondola bow POV gliding out of a shaded canal (steps, moored boats, brick and white stone buildings) into a wider basin: a white building with arched windows and a green iron-and-glass canopy over a water entrance, moored gondolas, a small bridge at right, and a gondolier rowing another gondola across in front of the prow (~23-26 s); flat soft late-afternoon light.
camera_motion: near-static 0-6 s, slow forward glide (push-in) with a gentle pan left as the gondola turns 6-21 s, steady 21-33 s
best: 22.5-26.0s (gondolier rowing a gondola across the basin ahead of the prow) / 15.5-18.5s (approaching the junction: white palazzo with arched windows and a small bridge)
notes: Basin not identifiable (no signage).

location: Venice - narrow canals and bridges (gondola ride, exact spot unknown)
content: Gondola bow POV: passes under a low white-stone bridge with an iron railing (0-12 s), a dark arch frames the canal junction ahead (14-18 s), emerges among pink-plaster and brick palazzi with greenery (20-26 s), then glides past a pink-brick wall toward a small bridge with people on it (27-48 s); finally swings back to the laughing passengers - an older man in glasses, a man in a white T-shirt, a woman in black - and the gondolier in a striped shirt (51-59 s); soft shaded light.
camera_motion: steady forward glide (push-in) 0-48 s with slight pans left; pan right/roll back to the passengers 48-51 s, then handheld on the faces; blurred last second
best: 0.0-4.0s (prow approaching a white stone bridge over the canal) / 41.5-45.5s (gliding toward a small bridge with people, pink brick walls) / 15.0-18.0s (dark arch frames the canal junction ahead)
notes: Passengers' faces very close at 51-59 s - cut before 48 s.

location: Venice - narrow canal (gondola ride, exact spot unknown)
content: Gondola bow POV: approaches and passes under a wide stone arched bridge with an iron railing (0-17 s, long dark underside), glides along a pale Istrian-stone palazzo wall with houses of barred windows mirrored in the green water (20-60 s), past arched water doors and white stone corners (60-70 s) into a narrow brick canal (75-84 s); ends on the gondola's floral cushion; soft shaded light.
camera_motion: steady forward glide (push-in) with slow pull-outs; slight tilts and pans right near the end; tilts down to the seat in the last second
best: 40.0-44.0s (barred windows reflected in the green water, steady glide) / 60.0-63.0s (arched water door and white stone corner) / 0.0-2.0s (approach to a stone arched bridge with an iron railing)
notes: Weakest of the bow POVs; use only as filler.

location: Venice - narrow canal (rio) on a gondola ride, exact canal unknown
content: Gondola ride POV from the bow: the black lacquered prow with gold trim centred at the bottom of frame, gliding along a narrow Venetian rio between weathered brick and plaster walls with plants growing from the masonry, green water, bright pastel houses at the canal mouth. 13-16 s: swing to companions in the gondola (older man in white T-shirt and glasses smiling, man in light-blue shirt, someone photographing with a phone) and a gondolier in a red-white striped shirt on another gondola in a side canal. 17.5-19 s: look up at a cream palazzo against clear blue sky. 22-41 s: very narrow, deeply shaded canal leading to a bright opening with pastel facades. Soft late-afternoon light, canal in shade.
camera_motion: forward glide (gondola POV, steady) 0-11.5 s; quick pan right with roll and shake to the companions 12-14 s; tilt up to the facades 15-19 s; pan back left/down past a dark wall 19-22 s; steady forward glide again 22-38 s; tilt down to the red seat cushion at the end
best: 6.0-10.0s (sharpest stretch of the gondola-prow glide along the green canal with plants on the brick wall) / 26.0-30.0s (prow gliding down a dark, tight canal toward the bright pastel-lit canal mouth - strong leading lines) / 17.5-19.0s (look-up at a cream palazzo against blue sky (slightly soft))
notes: Classic Venice gondola POV; best used in short 2-4 s cuts from the steady forward segments. Companions' faces close to camera at 13-15 s (avoid). A white street nameplate at top-left at 0-1.5 s is not legible.

location: Venice - lagoon waterfront at a vaporetto-style pontoon (exact stop unknown)
content: Early-morning view from a waterfront over a wide, choppy green lagoon under blue sky with streaky clouds: a tall white exhibition banner reading 'WAVES' (curator and artist names below) on the left edge, a floating vaporetto-style waiting pontoon with mooring poles in the midground, and a distant low skyline with a campanile and dome on the horizon. Bright, clean morning light; no people.
camera_motion: near-static 0-2 s; slight pan left with small push 2-3 s (banner fills left edge); pan back right with some shake 3-5 s
best: 2.0-3.3s ('WAVES' banner legible on the left, pontoon and lagoon horizon - usable as a sign/establishing beat)
notes: Very short (4.9 s) and continues directly into DJI_0184 (same spot, 9 s later). The distant campanile on the horizon is too small to identify with certainty.

location: Venice - lagoon waterfront at a vaporetto-style pontoon (same spot as DJI_0183, exact stop unknown)
content: 0-2.5 s arm-held selfie: young man with glasses and white shirt, face filling the frame, on a busy waterfront walkway (railing, pastel quay buildings, other tourists) next to the white 'WAVES' exhibition pillar, then he points at the banner. 3.5-9.4 s: camera turns to the lagoon - 'WAVES' pillar on the left, vaporetto-style pontoon with mooring poles, wide choppy green water, distant skyline with a campanile and dome under blue sky with streaky clouds; a seagull flies across the frame ~5-6 s. Clean morning light.
camera_motion: static selfie 0-2 s; pan right onto the banner while he points 2-3.5 s; pan right to the lagoon with slight pull-out 3.5-6 s; small tilt up/push-in with shake 6-9 s; ends tilting down/left
best: 5.0-6.2s (seagull flying across the lagoon in front of the pontoon and horizon) / 3.5-4.8s ('WAVES' banner, pontoon and lagoon horizon)
notes: Selfie (face fills frame 0-2.5 s) - score lowered by 2 per client preference. Lagoon half duplicates DJI_0183 (same spot, seconds later).

location: Venice - covered vaporetto pontoon (likely same stop as DJI_0183/0184, exact stop unknown)
content: Boarding queue inside a covered vaporetto-style pontoon: backs of a dense crowd of tourists (older man in black cap, blue-white striped shirt and black backpack, people in sun hats) shuffling toward a bright, overexposed opening with red boards; white panelled walls and windows on both sides, wooden floor. A companion's dark hair intermittently intrudes on the left edge. Flat, bright daylight from outside.
camera_motion: static handheld (chest height) throughout
best: 5.0-7.5s (cleanest view of the crowd queuing toward the bright opening (no hair in frame))
notes: Filler/transition at best - waiting-in-line footage.

location: Venice - aboard a vaporetto on the lagoon (distant island church with campanile, not confirmed which)
content: Inside a vaporetto cabin crossing the lagoon on a bright morning. 0-2 s: view through the large cabin windows (dark frames) over sparkling green-blue water to a distant island church with a tall campanile and a low skyline under blue sky. From ~2.5 s: tilt down to two backlit passengers in near-silhouette - a man (back of head) on the left and a long-haired woman in white-rimmed sunglasses close to the lens on the right, looking down - with the window behind showing the lagoon, the distant campanile and red-and-white boats.
camera_motion: slight pan right at the window 0-2 s; tilt down with slight pull-out to the passengers 2.5-5 s; static 5-12 s; small push-in with roll at the end
best: 0.0-1.8s (lagoon and distant campanile framed by the vaporetto windows) / 6.0-9.0s (backlit passenger silhouettes against the window with lagoon and campanile - moody in-transit beat)
notes: Companion close to the lens in silhouette (not a clear selfie, face not readable). Same boat trip as DJI_0187.

location: Venetian lagoon - aboard a boat (shoreline not identifiable)
content: View through a water-spotted boat window: churning white wake and green lagoon water in the foreground, a low flat island shoreline on the horizon (brick and pastel buildings, a yellow-hulled boat moored, a dark tower/crane silhouette), blue sky with light clouds. Dark window frame on the right edge; droplets and reflections visible on the glass. Bright morning sun.
camera_motion: static 0-3 s; slow pan left 3-6 s; pan right 6-9 s; pan right with push-in 9-10.5 s as the window pillar enters frame
best: 4.5-7.0s (window frame out of shot, frothy wake foreground with level horizon - generic boat-crossing beat)
notes: Shot through dirty glass; same boat trip as DJI_0186.

location: Venetian canal-side fondamenta with café parasols (exact place unknown)
content: Handheld walk along a sunny canal-side fondamenta: a row of cream café parasols and tables lining the canal on the left, red and pink brick houses with green awnings across the water, peeling plaster facades with shop signs and an iron lantern bracket on the right, blue sky. Tourists with backpacks walk ahead; a companion's dark hair is at the bottom of frame. From ~4.5 s the camera tilts down onto a woman in a black floral dress with a tan bag walking ahead on the paving, and ends with a finger over the lens. Hard morning sun with deep shadows.
camera_motion: forward handheld walk with slight pan right 0-4 s; fast tilt down with roll and shake 4-5.5 s; finger covers the lens at the end
best: 0.0-2.0s (walking past canal-side café parasols with pink brick houses across the water under blue sky)
notes: Short; only the first 2 s are clean. No legible signage to name the place.

location: Venetian canal with a portico and work boat (exact place unknown)
content: From under a shaded portico (dark stone columns in the foreground) looking across a canal: a work boat with a blue hydraulic crane arm unloading large white slabs, a silhouetted worker in dark clothes standing by it, and across the water a sunlit row of white, pink and ochre houses with shopfronts, awnings and a crowd strolling the opposite fondamenta under deep blue sky. 7-8.5 s pans right along the portico past men in grey T-shirts; ends tilting down to feet on the stone paving. Hard morning sun.
camera_motion: near-static with slight tilt up 0-3 s; slight pan right with small push-in 3-6.5 s; pan right along the portico 6.5-8.5 s; tilt down to the pavement 8.5-9.6 s
best: 0.0-3.0s (layered portico-column frame on the crane boat, worker silhouette and colourful canal houses) / 3.5-6.0s (same layered view, worker shifting by the crane, pedestrians on the far bank)
notes: Authentic working-canal moment; pair with DJI_0188 (same area two minutes apart). Discard after 8 s (feet/pavement).

content: Accidental 1.8 s recording with the camera upside down: white stone bridge steps in hard sun and shadow, then an inverted view of a pink house with balconies, an ornate iron bridge railing and blue sky at the bottom of frame; a fingertip covers the left third throughout.
camera_motion: fast tilt with pull-out while the camera is being raised (upside down), settling at the end
notes: Accidental pocket/handling footage; upside down with finger over the lens. Unusable.

location: Venetian campo with brick church and canal bridge (exact church unknown)
content: Sunny campo beside a large plain brick church with arched and round windows: a white Istrian-stone bridge with iron railings rises on the left over a canal where workers in hi-vis vests load trolleys from a cargo boat; pastel pink/orange houses and trees across the water, deep blue sky. From ~4 s the camera follows tourists climbing the bridge steps - a woman in a red top and wide white trousers, a man in a green shirt, a woman in black - with the brick church facade behind them. Hard morning sun, strong shadows.
camera_motion: near-static with slight pan right/tilt up 0-2 s; pan left following people onto the bridge 2-5 s; faster pan left and tilt down with push-in as the operator climbs the steps 5-7 s
best: 4.5-6.5s (tourists in red/white climbing the white bridge steps against the brick church facade) / 0.0-2.5s (wide campo: bridge, brick church, canal with workers loading a cargo boat)
notes: Tourists' faces are small; nobody is filming themselves. Follows DJI_0190 (accidental) at the same bridge.

content: Church interior: a black votive-candle stand with rows of red candles in the foreground beside a marble pillar base, a dark carved saint statue on a pedestal behind it, and down the nave an apse with a painted/gilded altarpiece, arched windows, a chandelier and wooden pews over a red-and-white patterned marble floor. 0-2 s companions (man in glasses with black T-shirt and blue backpack, man in navy polo, long-haired woman) stand in front of the camera; 8.5-9.4 s a man in a navy polo steps into the right edge. Soft window light, warm interior.
camera_motion: slow push-in with slight pan right past the companions 0-3 s; pan right/tilt up with small push 3-6 s; handheld near-static with jitter 6-9.4 s
best: 5.0-6.5s (candle stand centred with the saint statue and the apse behind - clean layered interior detail) / 2.5-3.0s (clear view of the nave and apse past the candle rack)
notes: Likely the interior of the brick church seen in DJI_0191 (two minutes later), but nothing in frame names it. Companions' faces visible at 0-1.5 s.

content: Wide-angle view of a bright church nave: grey stone columns carrying round arches, white walls, a dark timber-beamed ceiling, ornate Venetian-glass chandeliers hanging over rows of wooden pews, round oculus windows, large dark canvases on the walls, red-and-white chequered marble floor; a few visitors small in the distance. Even daylight from the windows. Ends tilting down to the chequered floor and a hand over the lens.
camera_motion: near-static 0-6 s (slight sway); slow pan right with small push-in 6-9 s; pan left then quick tilt down to the floor 9-12 s
best: 0.0-3.5s (sharpest, steady wide of the nave with glass chandeliers, columns and arches) / 7.0-8.0s (glass chandelier top-centre with oculus window and column during the slow pan) / 8.5-10.0s (end wall with oculus windows, pews and chandeliers)
notes: Same church visit as DJI_0192 (two minutes later); church not identifiable from signage. Few people, clean interior.

content: 0-2 s: walking behind companions (long-haired woman, man in navy polo) off a bridge into a sunny campo of red-brick houses with green shutters and a campanile behind. ~3.5 s: quick look over a canal with moored boats, wooden mooring poles and pastel houses. 4.5-14 s: low-angle walking selfie of the young man in white shirt and dark vest with backpack straps against blue sky, sun and lens flare in frame, brick facades with lanterns. 15-18.8 s: pan along a red-brick wall with a doorway (two older men) and a white sign with a red emblem (not legible). Harsh, bright morning sun.
camera_motion: forward walk following companions 0-2 s; fast pan right over the canal 2-4 s; swing round into a walking selfie 4-5 s; handheld selfie walk with drifting pan right and roll 5-14 s; fast pan right along a brick wall 14.5-18 s; pan left at the end
best: 0.0-2.0s (following companions from behind into a sunny brick campo with a campanile) / 3.0-4.0s (passing view over a canal with moored boats and mooring poles (sharp))
notes: Walking selfie (arm-held, face fills frame 4.5-14 s) - score lowered by 2 per client preference. Only the first 4 s are useful.

content: Glassblowing demonstration inside a large industrial glass furnace workshop: high dark timber-truss roof with hanging lamps, brick furnaces and metal equipment, a glassblower in a black T-shirt carrying a long blowpipe to the furnace (4-10 s) and a master glassblower seated at his bench (14-33 s), other workers and visitors crossing the floor in the background. Foreground: a wooden barrier with white printed notices (QR codes, social-media icons) and a grey concrete pillar with a paper sheet occupying the right quarter. 0-2.5 s companions (woman in white top, straw hat brim, a man's shoulder) pass the lens; ends tilting down to feet. Mixed daylight and warm lamps.
camera_motion: camera raised past companions with pan left/tilt up and shake 0-3 s; static (handheld, very steady) 3-33 s with tiny reframes at ~13 s and ~22 s; tilt down to feet 33-35 s
best: 6.0-10.0s (glassblower carrying a blowpipe across the workshop toward the furnace) / 18.5-22.5s (master glassblower working at his bench while a worker walks across the floor)
notes: Craft beat (glassblowing) but subjects are small; crop to the left 3/4 to lose the pillar. No legible signage naming the furnace (the canal/boat sequence around it is consistent with a lagoon glass-island visit, unconfirmed).

content: Wide view across a big, bright glass-factory hall with skylights and steel roof trusses: a glassworker in an orange T-shirt with a blowpipe moves around the floor, a glowing orange furnace mouth/molten gob on the left (~3.5-7 s), seated workers at benches, a tall blue glass sculpture/chandelier frame mid-hall, and visitors watching in the foreground (man in a white cap and grey T-shirt filming with a phone on the right, heads at bottom left). Cool overhead light. Ends with a fast swing into passing visitors.
camera_motion: static (steady handheld) 0-8.5 s; fast pan/whip into nearby visitors 8.5-10.2 s
best: 3.5-7.0s (glassworker in orange by the glowing furnace with the skylit hall behind) / 0.0-2.5s (wide establishing view of the glass workshop and spectators)
notes: Same glass-furnace visit as DJI_0195 (different, brighter hall). No legible signage naming the place.

content: Glass-furnace demonstration (same timber-truss hall as DJI_0195): a grey-haired master glassblower in a black T-shirt stands behind a steel marver table turning a glowing red-hot gob of glass on a long blowpipe (0-7.5 s), then walks toward the camera side (8.5-9.5 s) and works seated at his bench by the furnace (10-14.8 s). Foreground: a white notice on the barrier reading 'HELP MORE PEOPLE DISCOVER OUR ART! FOLLOW US ON TIKTOK!' with a QR code; grey concrete pillar on the right edge; workshop machinery and hanging lamps behind. Mixed daylight and warm lamps.
camera_motion: small push-in/reframe 0-3 s; static (steady handheld) 3-12 s; slight pan right 12-14.8 s
best: 2.5-6.0s (master glassblower rolling the red-hot glass at the marver - clearest craft moment) / 10.0-13.0s (glassblower working at his bench by the furnace, workshop depth behind)
notes: Best of the three glass-furnace clips (DJI_0195-0197). Crop or blur the TikTok notice at lower right. No legible signage naming the place.

content: Busy working quay on a wide canal in harsh late-morning sun: a moored cargo boat with a crane swinging pallets of purple-labelled boxes ashore, men in white shirts and a man in a dark polo talking on his phone walking toward camera, iron railings and mooring poles, and across the bright green water a row of red, pink and ochre palazzi under clear blue sky. 6.5-9 s a yellow forklift with a driver in a vest carries the boxes past the camera; a companion with a blue backpack seen from behind at the end. The operator's fingertip intrudes on the right edge repeatedly (0.5 s, 2.5-6.5 s).
camera_motion: slow forward walk (push-in) 0-6 s; pan left with pull-out following the forklift 6-9 s
best: 0.0-1.4s (crane unloading on the quay with men walking and the canal houses behind, finger mostly out of frame) / 7.5-8.5s (forklift with boxes against the canal and palazzi)
notes: Finger over the lens edge for much of the clip; crop needed. Working-island delivery scene like DJI_0189.

content: Low-angle view across a sunny paved campo to a tall freestanding brick campanile with a white clock face against deep blue sky, red flags at the top-left, a leafy tree and dark cypresses beside it, a low arcaded brick building with a white marble relief monument at the tower's base, and a brick church facade with a round window on the right. Harsh, clear late-morning sun. Ends swinging down to the paving and a companion's arm.
camera_motion: near-static with slight pan left and small push-in 0-2 s; slow tilt down with push-in 2-4 s; fast pan right and tilt down to the ground 4-5.7 s
best: 0.0-2.0s (brick campanile with clock centred against deep blue sky, trees and memorial below) / 2.0-3.5s (slightly wider view including the church facade on the right)
notes: Good establishing beat but only ~3.5 s usable. Probably the same campo as the brick church in DJI_0191, but no signage names it.

content: Walking up to an open church doorway in a sunlit brick facade with white stone jambs and heavy dark weathered wooden doors; inside on a stand a white bilingual sign 'CONTRIBUTO DI ACCESSO PER LA VISITA / ACCESS FEE FOR VISIT - full 3,50 EUR, students 1,50 EUR, free... CASH ONLY' (red 'CASH ONLY'), dim interior with notices and a wooden screen behind. Bright exterior, dark interior.
camera_motion: forward walk (push-in) toward the doorway with slight pan right 0-4 s, accelerating push-in to the sign 4-5.5 s
best: 3.2-4.7s (dark wooden doors framing the 'CASH ONLY' entry-fee sign)
notes: Informational sign shot (entry fee, cash only); Italian/English text confirms Italy but not which church.

content: Wide, symmetric view down the nave of a basilica-style church: twin colonnades of red marble columns with white capitals carrying round arches banded in red and white, white walls with small arched windows, a dark timber ceiling, rows of red chairs, dark crucifixes and small red lamps on the walls, and a golden mosaic glowing in the apse half-dome at the vanishing point. Starts over a wooden ticket desk with a printed notice; a light-wood panel intrudes on the right at 7-8 s. Soft, dim daylight interior; no visitors in view.
camera_motion: pan left with slight tilt up and pull-out clearing the ticket desk 0-3 s; static 3-6 s; slight pan right with shake 6-9 s (panel enters right); pan left with slight roll 9-10.5 s
best: 3.5-6.0s (steady, sharp centred nave - red colonnades converging on the glowing golden apse) / 2.0-3.0s (same symmetric nave as the camera settles) / 9.5-10.5s (closer column capital on the left with the nave receding (sharp))
notes: Best church interior of this batch; no signage names the church (entry-fee sign in DJI_0210 just before). Brighten slightly in grade.

content: Dim church side chapel: a white marble altar topped by an ornate silver reliquary/tabernacle, frescoed walls and an arched window behind, a column wrapped in red damask on the left, a bronze candlestick and wall lantern. From ~5.5 s a fast swing down past red chairs to a dark geometric mosaic floor (blurred). Low light.
camera_motion: slow pan right with slight roll 0-5 s; fast pan right and tilt down to the floor with shake 5-7.5 s
best: 3.0-4.5s (silver reliquary altar framed by the red damask column and frescoed wall (sharpest))
notes: Same church as DJI_0211 likely (red columns), unconfirmed. Mosaic floor at 6.5-7 s is too dark and blurred to use.

content: Very dark church side chapel: a glass-topped tomb/display case on a stone base, processional lanterns with red glass on tall poles, cream banners bearing a red double (patriarchal) cross, a black electric votive-candle box with red LED lights, QR-code notices, pebbled floor. At 0-0.5 s a visitor in a black T-shirt photographs the case with a phone. Dim, murky light.
camera_motion: handheld pan right with tilt down 0-3 s; fast pan right and tilt up with roll and shake 3-6 s; fast pan back left 6-9 s; tilt down with small push-in at the end
best: 6.0-6.6s (cream banner with red double cross between red-glass lanterns (sharpest moment))
notes: Too dark and shaky for the montage; same church visit as DJI_0211/0212 (unconfirmed).

content: Slow walk down a dim church side aisle toward a small lit side altar under an arched window, a pale green Venetian-glass chandelier hanging in front of it; red damask-wrapped column in the left foreground, white wall with red hanging sanctuary lamps and Stations of the Cross on the right, dark pews and a patterned stone/mosaic floor catching window light. Moody low light.
camera_motion: steady forward walk (push-in) 0-3.7 s; quick pan left with blur 3.7-4.4 s
best: 0.0-2.5s (push-in down the aisle toward the lit altar with green glass chandelier and red lamps) / 3.0-3.6s (closer view of the altar framed by red column and sanctuary lamps)
notes: Short; same church as DJI_0211-0213 likely (unconfirmed). Lift shadows in grade.

content: Church detail: a stone font covered by a round, glittering glass-mosaic disc in yellow, green and red, topped by a small carved dark-wood statue of a saint with a raised right arm, standing against a plain whitewashed wall with small labels. The camera tilts up from the shimmering glass disc to the statue and back down to the disc. Soft, dim window light.
camera_motion: tilt up from the disc to the statue 0-2 s; hold/slow tilt down with slight pull-out 2-5 s; continued tilt down onto the disc 5-7 s, blurred at the very end
best: 4.5-6.0s (shimmering multicoloured glass-mosaic disc on the font) / 1.5-3.0s (carved wooden saint with raised arm against the plain white wall)
notes: Nice texture/detail insert (colourful glass) but small-scale; same church visit as DJI_0211-0214 (unconfirmed).

content: Quiet residential lane on a bright sunny morning: first a blurred look along a peeling pink plaster wall at an open green workshop door (no. 16), then a POV walk down a narrow calle paved with irregular grey flagstones between old brick walls and cream houses with green shutters, trees spilling over garden walls, deep blue sky, hard sun and crisp shadows. No people.
